exposure: cervical length at 37 weeks of pregnancy
cohort: 126 low-risk pregnant women with cephalic presentation who were not in labor
finding: Cervical length at 37 weeks of pregnancy was a significant predictor of spontaneous labor onset, but not mode of delivery.
mod_finding: While cervical length at 37 weeks did not predict mode of delivery overall, further analysis may reveal if extreme cervical lengths are associated with specific delivery modes.
